$comment: Generation order for scripts/voice/generate.mjs. Tiers run top to bottom; inside a tier lines follow play order; the first tier that matches a line takes it. Selector keys (AND inside one selector, OR across the list): ids (globs, * and ?), beats ('<chapter>:<beatId>' globs), chapter, pack, source ('pack'|'story'|'quest'), quests (quest-id globs), all. Quest lines carry no id in the game; their ids here are 'quest.<questId>.<field>.<n>' and playback has to match them by textHash.
